question: How does Route 53 treat a disabled health check, and how do you stop routing traffic to its resource?
claim: After you disable a health check, Route 53 considers its status to always be healthy and, if you configured DNS failover, continues to route traffic to the corresponding resources. To stop routing traffic to a resource, invert the health check.

evidence.quote: After you disable a health check, Route 53 considers the status of the health check to always be healthy. If you configured DNS failover, Route 53 continues to route traffic to the corresponding resources. If you want to stop routing traffic to a resource, invert the health check.
